items.item_text: Must be able to work various hours and locations based on business needs.
May be required to float to other sites to provide coverage as needed.
Employment is subject to a criminal background check and pre-employment physical.
A minimum of three (3) years previous related experience in a large complex healthcare setting.
EPIC-Cadence, EMR, Template and scheduling experience.
Experience in a fast-paced, multi-specialty clinic.

Possess the personal characteristics of professionalism, credibility, commitment to high standards, innovation, able to maintain strict confidentiality with experience applying good judgment and discretion.

Under supervision, the Front Desk Coordinator is the first point of contact for patients. Performs a variety of clerical and receptionist duties in support of daily patient services within clinical areas: greets patients, check in and check out procedures. Multi-specialty clinic appointment scheduling, insurance and authorization verification, updating patient demographics, audit billing documents, disposition appointments, co-pay collection, managing/monitoring petty cash drawer, and working closely as a resource for managers, physicians, nurses, staff and other UCSDH departments. Other related duties as assigned.

Self-starter who is accountable and requires minimal direction and supervision; a person who is open to new ideas; and a creative and flexible individual who is comfortable working in a large, complex organization.
Proven knowledge of third-party payors including federal, state, and private health plans.
Strong problem-solving ability by using good judgment and applying these skills to assist customers and ensure customers' expectations are met.
Proven ability to work in an interactive environment and possess excellent customer service skills both in person and over phone.
Excellent communication skills with the ability to communicate clearly both verbally and in writing.
Proficiency using Microsoft Applications i.e., Outlook Email, Outlook Calendar, Teams, Word and Excel. Proven computer skills and be able to work between multiple systems during calls.
Strong organizational skills. Ability to set priorities, handle deadlines and manage conflicting demands with limited supervision.
